name: claudius
description: Make songs with Claude: Claudius writes, arranges, mixes and judges them, in the studio you have open.
long_description:
Claudius is a beatmaker that listens to its own songs. With this extension, Claude makes and edits songs in Claudius: it starts from a genre or writes a script, renders the song, listens through Claudius' critic and revises it, while you hear every change in the studio.

The extension starts the Claudius app, so install the app first: download it from [claudius.devlato.com](https://claudius.devlato.com) and drag it into Applications. Claudius' skills, which teach Claude the craft, are zips to upload in Claude's settings, under Capabilities: the studio's Connect an assistant writes them.

claudius.title: Claudius program
claudius.description: The program inside Claudius.app that the extension starts. Change it if the app is not in Applications.
